description: This file defines the ProjectSecurityRequirement class, which generates security requirement information for Drupal core projects, including handling security coverage based on versions and dates.

classes.name: ProjectSecurityRequirement
classes.description: A class for generating and managing security requirement information for Drupal core projects, including version and date-based security coverage assessments.

methods.name: createFromProjectDataAndSecurityCoverageInfo
methods.description: Creates an instance of ProjectSecurityRequirement based on project data and security coverage info, filtering for core projects with the name 'drupal'.

methods.name: getRequirement
methods.description: Returns the security coverage requirement array, either based on version end or date end info.

methods.name: getVersionEndRequirement
methods.description: Generates requirement info based on security coverage until a specific version.

methods.name: getVersionEndCoverageMessage
methods.description: Creates a message indicating security coverage status related to version end, including links and coverage messages.

methods.name: getDateEndRequirement
methods.description: Generates requirement info based on security coverage until a specific date.

methods.name: getVersionNoSecurityCoverageMessage
methods.description: Provides a message prompting update for unsupported versions.

methods.name: getReleaseCycleLink
methods.description: Returns a link to the Drupal release cycle overview page.
